title: Time series: components, stationarity and autocorrelation
description: Trend, seasonality and noise, stationarity and differencing, the sample autocorrelation function, baselines and why random splits leak the future.

title: Autoregressive models and walk-forward validation
description: AR(p) models fitted by least squares on lagged values, recursive multi-step forecasting and leakage-free walk-forward evaluation.

title: Anomaly detection
description: Modelling normality: z-scores and masking, robust statistics, Mahalanobis distance, local outlier factor, contamination as a threshold, and evaluation with few labels.

title: Isolation forests
description: Random-cut isolation trees on subsamples, path-length normalisation c(n) and the anomaly score 2^(-E[h]/c).

title: Hyper-parameter search
description: Grid, random and successive-halving search, why random beats grid when few parameters matter, and validation-set overfitting through many trials.

title: Bayesian optimisation and Gaussian-process surrogates
description: RBF kernels, the Gaussian-process posterior mean and variance via Cholesky, expected improvement and the exploration-exploitation trade-off.

title: ML pipelines that prevent leakage
description: Ordered transformer and model steps fitted only on training folds, cross-validating the whole pipeline and nested validation for tuning.

title: Feature selection
description: Filter, wrapper and embedded methods, mutual information, redundancy and doing selection inside cross-validation.

title: The lasso and regularisation paths
description: L1 penalty, derivation of soft-thresholding, coordinate descent, lambda_max, KKT conditions, bias from shrinkage and stability selection.

title: t-SNE
description: Perplexity-calibrated Gaussian affinities, Student-t map affinities, the KL objective and its gradient, and the limits of reading t-SNE plots.

title: Kernel PCA
description: PCA through the centred Gram matrix with an RBF kernel, non-linear components, cost and the pre-image problem.

title: Model-agnostic interpretation: permutation importance and partial dependence
description: Shuffling features to measure reliance, averaging predictions over a grid, ICE curves and the caveats with correlated features.

title: Shapley values and SHAP
description: Fair credit assignment over feature coalitions, efficiency, the linear-model special case, approximations and what explanations can and cannot say.
